effect_description_eng:
[Your Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, you may suspend this Tamer to gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon with [Gallantmon] or [Growlmon] in its name, that Digimon gains "[When Digivolving] ＜Blitz＞ (If your opponent has 1 or more memory, this Digimon may attack.)." for the turn.
